rules: Generated characters exist for a live-world reason, not merely because the player asked who is nearby.
Generation must respect staffing, faction, date, location and qualification constraints.
Species selection does not generate personality stereotypes.
No generated NPC receives famous-canon relationships without explicit campaign justification.
Generated characters persist once introduced unless the campaign explicitly discards them.
Names and presentation must avoid accidental collisions with canonical characters where validation can detect them.
Academy cadets generated from Academy population must follow the Academy-specific materialization contract and consume a real cadet population slot.
